description:
Set sail from Albufeira on an unforgettable adventure along the Algarve coastline aboard our Dreamer, a 47-seat jet-powered boat. Combining dolphin watching with a spectacular cave cruise, this experience is the perfect way to discover some of the Algarve’s most impressive natural landscapes from a completely unique perspective, viewed from the sea.

As you cruise along the coast, keep your eyes open for wild dolphins swimming in their natural habitat. Our highly trained team, including marine biologists on board, can share fascinating insights into the species you may encounter and help you understand more about their behaviour and environment. As dolphins are wild animals, sightings cannot be guaranteed, but every trip offers the chance to experience the excitement of searching for them in the open sea.

The adventure continues along the dramatic Algarve coastline, where mysterious cliffs, golden rock formations and hidden caves create a constantly changing backdrop. The unique shapes of the rock formations let your imagination run wild, as each person can see something different in them — from a seated lion to a submarine. Some of the caves reveal fascinating traces of the past, including fossils of animals that once inhabited our coast, while others offer a truly unique sight: rocky walls dotted with birds’ nests, where wildlife has made its home. Explore these remarkable natural spaces from the water and discover a side of the Algarve that is impossible to experience from land.

There is also time to enjoy a refreshing swim in the Atlantic, when sea and weather conditions allow. So bring your swimsuit and towel and be ready to make the most of your time on the water.

Whether you are travelling with family, friends or as a couple, this experience brings together nature, adventure and the beauty of the Algarve coast in one memorable boat trip from Albufeira.
highlights: Search for wild dolphins in their natural habitat along the Algarve coast
Learn about marine species from our highly trained team and marine biologists
Explore spectacular caves and unique rock formations from the sea
Enjoy a refreshing swim and unforgettable views of the Algarve coastline

description:
There are experiences that stay with you forever, and seeing dolphins leaping in total freedom in their natural habitat is undoubtedly one of them. This exclusive tour invites you to immerse yourself in the wild beauty of the Algarve, combining the adrenaline of whale watching with the discovery of the majestic Benagil Cave, Portugal's most iconic rock formation.

More than just a boat trip, this is an opportunity for learning and discovery. Throughout the journey, you will be accompanied by a passionate marine biologist, who will share fascinating facts about the most common species in our region, such as the "common dolphin" and the "bottlenose dolphin." You will learn about their social habits, migratory routes, and the vital role they play in the marine ecosystem.

The route takes us along cliffs sculpted by time, revealing geological secrets and deserted beaches. This experience is designed for all ages, ensuring a relaxed and safe environment where respect for nature and the well-being of the animals is always our top priority.

This activity is carried out on a catamaran, equipped with a toilet and free WiFi.

What to expect from this tour?
• Catamaran cruise along the Algarve coast
• Visit to Benagil Cave, one of the Algarve’s most iconic landmarks
• Dolphin watching in the wild, guided by a marine biologist
• Insightful commentary about the species, their diet and behaviour

Combine the enchantment of wildlife with the mythical beauty of the Benagil Cave on a unique expedition along the Algarve coast. Guided by an expert marine biologist, we guarantee a safe, educational, and thrilling journey for all ages. Book your spot now and prepare for the most special encounter of your holiday.

description:
Enjoy a guided boat trip between Albufeira and Benagil Caves on a tour that combines nature and adventure. Discover the Algarve coastline's most iconic landscapes and keep your eyes open for playful dolphins on the way.

Start your journey at the meeting point, where you will be welcomed by the crew.

After priority boarding, start your tour by cruising along the beautiful, 18-km-long Algarve coastline. Listen to your knowledgeable guide and learn all about the sights you pass by. Feel the relaxing sea breeze and be amazed by the coastal view.

Head inside the famous Benagil caves to admire this rock formation. Take amazing pictures of the caves and capture the light entering them. Spot São Rafael and Marinha beaches, among the most emblematic beaches in Portugal, famous for their cliffs and fine golden sand.

Make a short swimming stop and immerse yourself in the crystal clear waters of the Algarve coast. During the tour, look for the dolphins on the way. If they are spotted, see them playing in their natural environment and take photos of them jumping in and out of the water.

description:
Climb aboard a semi-rigid boat at Albufeira Marina and cruise 18 km along the Algarve coastline. With a skipper and onboard marine biologist, explore sea caves, including the iconic Benagil Cave (subject to access), and admire the Alfanzina Lighthouse.

Marvel at beaches, unique rock formations, and, if sea conditions allow, enjoy a refreshing swim. Try to spot wild dolphins in their natural environment while learning about local marine life through the insights of an experienced guide.

Please note: Dolphin sightings are not guaranteed, as they are completely wild animals and move freely in their natural habitat. Access to Benagil Cave is also subject to change without notice due to decisions by Portuguese Maritime authorities. Seacret-Tours is not responsible for restrictions imposed.
Due to prevailing winds along the Algarve coast, especially in the afternoons, the sea can become a bit choppier at the surface, with short waves and frequent splashes — especially on fast boats. We recommend wearing appropriate or waterproof clothing, particularly in the more exposed areas, for a more comfortable experience.

Benefit from a small boat cruise to make your way into narrow caves

Remember that wild dolphin sightings are not guaranteed

description:
Dolphins, Orcas, Whales and other cetaceans, are without a doubt some of the most fascinating animals that we can meet in the wild.

We invite you to enjoy an unforgettable boat tour in the company of these docile and playful mammals. Learn from marine experts on how they socialize, interact and communicate as they swim on your bow or surf the wake of your catamaran.

Witness their fantastic leaps out of the water and their amazing acrobatics as they chase their prey and dare you to take a photo.

Occasionally you can also marvel at the sighting of Orcas, the biggest apex predator on earth, that chases in these waters their favorite snack of all the Blue Fin Tuna.
